violation_type.title: Food Service and Preparation Requirement - Use Sanitary Holders (26 TAC §746.3317(6))
violation_type.short_title: Food Service and Preparation Requirement - Use Sanitary Holders
violation_type.typical_finding: Crackers were served on a bare table for children to eat from.

finding_variants.text: Crackers were served on a bare table for children to eat from.
Children were served their afternoon snack (cookies/crackers) on a bare table in a toddler room.
The AM snack of graham crackers was observed being  served directly on the table.
Children were observed at inspection eating crackers off the bare table.
The toddler classroom was having goldfish for snack and were not provided a plate or napkin for their food to rest on. The food was emptied from the pre packaging onto the bare table.
During the investigation, it was found that one class of infant and toddler aged children were served snack on the floor of their classroom.
